entry.name: jit.multiplex
entry.digest: Multiplex (interleave) two matrices into one matrix
entry.description: The jit.multiplex object takes two matrices as input, and derives a single output matrix from it by interleaving the input matrices across a specified dimension.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.digest: Matrix underflow mode
attributes.description: Matrix underflow mode (default = 0 (stop))0 = stop: If one input matrix is exhausted before the other, do nothing1 = wrap: If one input matrix is exhausted before the other, return to that matrix's beginning and continue until the second matrix is also exhausted2 = clip: If one input matrix is exhausted before the other, repeat that matrix's final sample until the second matrix is also exhausted

attributes.name: multiplexdim
attributes.digest: Dimension across which multiplexing occurs
attributes.description: The dimension across which multiplexing occurs (default = 0). The most common arguments specify horizontal (i.e., dim[0]) or vertical (dim[1]) multiplexing.

attributes.name: truncate
attributes.digest: Input truncation flag
attributes.description: Input truncation flag (default = 1) When the flag is set, the right input's dimensions are truncated to the left input's dimensions if the right dimensions are greater than the left. Truncation is performed for all dimensions except the multiplex dimension. Otherwise, no truncation occurs.
